events.name: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham had 29 points and 13 assists as the Detroit Pistons beat the New York Knicks 121-90 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cade Cunningham has 29 points, 13 assists as Pistons beat Knicks 121-90

headlines.description: — Anfernee Simons scored 27 points, Payton Pritchard had 21 and the Boston Celtics held the Chicago Bulls to 33 points in the opening half of a 115-101 victory on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Simons scores 27 points, Pritchard adds 21 as Celtics cruise past Bulls 115-101

headlines.description: — Rookie Collin Murray-Boyles scored 17 points as the Toronto Raptors beat the Atlanta Hawks 118-100 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray-Boyles scores 17, Raptors beat Hawks 118-100 to complete 2-game sweep of Atlanta

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 26 points and his 3-pointer with 1.1 seconds to go lifted the Houston Rockets to a 100-97 win over the Phoenix Suns on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant's 3-pointer in final seconds gives Rockets 100-97 win over the Suns

events.name: Charlotte Hornets at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Brandon Miller scored 28 points and the Charlotte Hornets stunned the NBA-leading Oklahoma City Thunder 124-97 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: NBA-leading Thunder humbled in 124-97 home loss to struggling Hornets

headlines.description: — Bruce Brown scored 19 points and got the winning bucket in overtime off a goaltending call on Joel Embiid, and Jalen Pickett had 29 points to lead the short-handed Denver Nuggets to a 125-124 win over the Philadelphia 76ers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown's goaltended layup in OT lifts short-handed Nuggets over 76ers 125-124

events.name: Golden State Warriors at LA Clippers

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard had 24 points and 12 rebounds, rookie Kobe Sanders added 20 points, and the Los Angeles Clippers edged the Golden State Warriors 103-102 on Monday night in a wild game that included Warriors coach Steve Kerr getting ejected and Steph...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kawhi Leonard leads Clippers past Warriors 103-102 in wild game with Kerr ejected, Curry fouled out

events.name: Utah Jazz at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija had 33 points, nine assists and eight rebounds in three quarters, falling just short of his second consecutive triple-double, and the Portland Trail Blazers routed the Utah Jazz 137-117 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Avdija scores 33 in latest outburst as Trail Blazers blow out Jazz, 137-117
